<P align=center style='font:11pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'><FONT style='font:12pt Times New Roman'>with Annex 1 (Registration Rights Agreement &#8211;&nbsp;Exhibit A to the Share Purchase Agreement) and Annex 2 (Form of Warrant to Purchase Class A Common Stock &#8211;&nbsp;Exhibit B to the Share Purchase Agreement)</FONT></P>
<P align=center style='font:11pt Cambria;margin:0'><FONT style='font-family:Times New Roman'>Executed copy (scanned). The Share Purchase Agreement dated as of August 29, 2024 is filed as Exhibit 10.1.</FONT></P>

<P align=center style='font:11pt Cambria;margin:0'><FONT style='font-family:Times New Roman'><IMG src=exhibit108amendmentno1tos_8.jpg width=631 height=817 alt=sp-9.png title=sp-9.png></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=center style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'><B>REGISTRATION RIGHTS AGREEMENT</B></P>
<P align=center style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=center style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;color:#000000'>This Registration Rights Agreement (this &#8220;Agreement&#8221;) is made and entered into (in connection with the Share Purchase Agreement) as of August 29th, 2024, by and among <B>BIOINTRA Corp. </B>a corporation incorporated under the laws of the State of Delaware whose registered office is at &nbsp;1041 N DUPONT HWY #1029&#160;DOVER, DE 1990 USA (the &#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Company</FONT>&#8221;); SILVER ROCK GROUP, formed under the laws of BVI having British Virgin Islands having its registered office at Sable Trust , road Town, Tortola, 13v1 (the &#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Holder</FONT>&#8221;); and together with the Company and Purchaser, the &#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Parties</FONT>&#8221;).</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'><B>1. Definitions</B></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>As used in this Agreement, the following terms shall have the meanings set forth below:</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>1.1 &#8220;Affiliate&#8221;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>Shall mean any entity controlling, controlled by, or under common control with a Holder.</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>1.2 &#8220;Commission&#8221; or &#8220;SEC&#8221;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>Shall mean the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>1.3 &#8220;Class A Common Stock&#8221;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>Shall mean shares of the Company&#8217;s Class A common stock</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>1.4 &#8220;Exchange Act&#8221;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>Shall mean the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended.</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>1.5 &#8220;Registrable Securities&#8221;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>Shall mean (i) shares of Class A Common Stock issuable pursuant to the Share Purchase Agreement / ELOC (ii) shares of Class A Common Stock held by Holder, (iii) shares issuable upon the exercise of warrants, including those exercised on a cashless basis, and (iii) any securities issued in respect thereof as a result of stock splits, stock dividends, or similar transactions.</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>1.6 &#8220;Registration Statement&#8221;</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>Shall mean a registration statement filed with the SEC to register the resale of Registrable Securities under the Securities Act.</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>1.7 &#8220;Securities Act&#8221;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>Shall mean the Securities Act of 1933, as amended.</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'><B>2. Registration Rights</B></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>2.1 &nbsp;Registration</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>The Company shall file a Registration Statement as soon as possible (such as S1) that will register the &#8220;Registrable Securities&#8221; as per section 1.6</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>2.2 Shelf Registration</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>(a) Continuous Availability: The Company shall use commercially reasonable efforts to maintain an effective Registration Statement covering the resale of the &#8220;Registrable Securities&#8221;.</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'><B>3. Registration Procedures</B></P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>The Company agrees to use commercially reasonable efforts to:</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Cambria;margin-left:36pt'>1.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD>Include the &#8220;Registrable Securities&#8221; as per section 1.6&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>in its Registration Statement</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Cambria;margin-left:36pt'>2.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD>Maintain effectiveness of such Registration Statement.&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Cambria;margin-left:36pt'>3.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD>Provide copies of the Prospectus to the Holders.&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Cambria;margin-left:36pt'>4.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD>Notify Holders of material developments affecting the Registration Statement.&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Cambria;margin-left:36pt'>5.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD>Provide necessary cooperation in the resale of Registrable Securities, including making executives available and providing customary legal opinions.&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>4.2 Delivery of Shares</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>The Company shall deliver the net number of shares electronically via DTC/DWAC/DRS  within 2 business days after receiving a notice of cashless exercise of the warrants</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>4.3 No Fractional Shares</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>No fractional shares shall be issued upon cashless exercise. The Company shall round down to the nearest whole share or pay cash in lieu of fractional shares.</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'><B>5. Indemnification</B></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>5.1 Indemnification by the Company</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>The Company shall indemnify each Holder for any losses, claims, damages, or liabilities arising out of:</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Cambria;margin-left:36pt'>1.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD>Any material misstatement or omission in a Registration Statement.&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Cambria;margin-left:36pt'>2.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD>Any violation of securities laws by the Company in connection with the registration process.&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>5.2 Indemnification by Holder</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>Each Holder shall indemnify the Company for any losses, claims, damages, or liabilities arising out of:</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Cambria;margin-left:36pt'>1.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD>Any material misstatements or omissions made in written information provided by such Holder.&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Cambria;margin-left:36pt'>2.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD>Any violations of securities laws by such Holder.&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'><B>6. Miscellaneous</B></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>6.1 Assignment</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>The rights under this Agreement may be assigned by any Holder to any permitted transferee of Registrable Securities.</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>6.2 Governing Law</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York without regard to conflicts of laws principles.</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>6.4 Counterparts</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which shall constitute the same agreement.</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties hereto have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>COMPANY:</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>

<P align=justify style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:3.55pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.45pt'>NEITHER THIS SECURITY NOR THE SECURITIES AS TO WHICH THIS SECURITY MAY BE EXERCISED HAVE BEEN REGISTERED WITH THE SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION OR THE SECURITIES COMMISSION OF ANY STATE IN RELIANCE UPON AN EXEMPTION FROM REGISTRATION UNDER THE SECURITIES ACT OF 1933, AS AMENDED (THE &#8220;SECURITIES ACT&#8221;), AND, ACCORDINGLY, MAY NOT BE OFFERED OR SOLD EXCEPT PURSUANT TO AN EFFECTIVE REGISTRATION STATEMENT UNDER THE SECURITIES ACT OR PURSUANT TO AN AVAILABLE EXEMPTION FROM, OR IN A TRANSACTION NOT SUBJECT TO, THE REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS OF THE SECURITIES ACT AND IN ACCORDANCE WITH APPLICABLE STATE SECURITIES LAWS AS EVIDENCED BY A LEGAL OPINION OF COUNSEL TO THE TRANSFEROR TO SUCH EFFECT. THIS SECURITY AND THE SECURITIES ISSUABLE UPON EXERCISE OF THIS SECURITY MAY BE PLEDGED IN CONNECTION WITH A BONA FIDE MARGIN ACCOUNT OR OTHER LOAN SECURED BY SUCH SECURITIES.</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>&nbsp;</P>

<P align=justify style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.1pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:7pt'>Date of Issuance: (<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Issuance Date</FONT>&#8221;)</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-right:9.55pt'>This CLASS A COMMON STOCK PURCHASE WARRANT (the &#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Warrant</FONT>&#8221;) certifies that, for value received (in connection with the Share Purchase Agreement (as defined below) of even date) dated October 10th, 2024, Silver </P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-right:9.55pt'>Rock Group, Ltd (including any permitted and registered assigns, the &#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Holder</FONT>&#8221;), is entitled, upon the terms and subject to the limitations on exercise and the conditions hereinafter set forth, at any time on or after the date of issuance hereof, to purchase from <B>BIOINTRA Corp</B>, a Delaware corporation (the &#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Company</FONT>&#8221;), ___________shares of Class A Common Stock (the &#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Warrant Shares</FONT>&#8221;) (whereby such number may be adjusted from time to time pursuant to the terms and conditions of this Warrant) at the Exercise Price per share calculated on a fully diluted basis, at an exercise price per Share equal to the lowest of $2 per share or<FONT style='font-family:Times New Roman'> 110% of the Listing</FONT> Price (or Acquisition Price in the case of an M&amp;A transaction) immediately after the completion of the Public Listing</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:4.65pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;text-indent:36pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.45pt'>Capitalized terms used in this Warrant shall have the meanings set forth in the Purchase Agreement unless otherwise defined in the body of this Warrant. For purposes of this Warrant, the term &#8220;Exercise Price&#8221; shall mean the lowest of $2 per share or<FONT style='font-family:Times New Roman'> 110% of the Listing</FONT> Price (or Acquisition Price in the case of an M&amp;A transaction) immediately after the completion of the Public Listing (including but not limited to cashless exercise), and the term &#8220;Exercise Period&#8221; shall mean the period commencing on the Issuance Date and ending on 5:00 p.m. eastern standard time on the five-year anniversary thereof.</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:4.65pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:79pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:-36pt'>1.</KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>EXERCISE OF WARRANT</FONT>.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:3.7pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-right:11.25pt'><I>Mechanics of Exercise</I>. Subject to the terms and conditions hereof, the rights represented by this Warrant may be exercised in whole or in part at any time or times during the Exercise Period by delivery of a written notice, in the form attached hereto as <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Exhibit I</FONT> (the &#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Exercise Notice</FONT>&#8221;), of the Holder&#8217;s election to exercise this Warrant. The Holder shall not be required to deliver the original Warrant in order to effect an exercise hereunder. Partial exercises of this Warrant resulting in purchases of a portion of the total number of Warrant </P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P align=justify style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:3.7pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-right:11.25pt'>Shares available hereunder shall have the effect of lowering the outstanding number of Warrant Shares purchasable hereunder in an amount equal to the applicable number of Warrant Shares purchased. On or before the second Trading Day (the &#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Warrant Share Delivery Date</FONT>&#8221;) following the date on which the Holder sent the Exercise Notice to the Company or the Company&#8217;s transfer agent, and upon receipt by the Company of payment to the Company of an amount equal to the applicable Exercise Price multiplied by the number of Warrant Shares as to which all or a portion of this Warrant is being exercised (the &#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Aggregate Exercise Price</FONT>&#8221; and together with the Exercise Notice, the &#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Exercise Delivery Documents</FONT>&#8221;) in cash or by wire transfer of immediately  available funds (or by cashless exercise, in which case there shall be no Aggregate Exercise Price provided), the Company shall (or direct its transfer agent to) issue and deliver by overnight courier to the address as specified in the Exercise Notice, a certificate, registered in the Company&#8217;s share register in the name of the Holder or its designee, for the number of shares of Class A Common Stock to which the Holder is entitled pursuant to such exercise (or deliver such shares of Class A Common Stock in electronic format if requested by the Holder). Upon delivery of the Exercise Delivery Documents, the Holder shall be deemed for all corporate purposes to have become the holder of record of the Warrant Shares with respect to which this Warrant has been exercised, irrespective of the date of delivery of the certificates evidencing such Warrant Shares. If this Warrant is submitted in connection with any exercise and the number of Warrant Shares represented by this Warrant submitted for exercise is greater than the number of Warrant Shares being acquired upon an exercise, then the Company shall as soon as practicable and in no event later than three business days after any exercise and at its own expense, issue a new Warrant (in accordance with Section 6) representing the right to purchase the number of Warrant Shares purchasable immediately prior to such exercise under this Warrant, less the number of Warrant Shares with respect to which this Warrant is exercised.</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P align=justify style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;text-indent:36pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.45pt'>If the Company fails to cause its transfer agent to issue to the Holder the respective shares of Class A Common Stock by the respective Warrant Share Delivery Date, then the Holder will have the right to rescind such exercise in Holder&#8217;s sole discretion in addition to all other rights and remedies at law, under this Warrant, or otherwise, and such failure shall also be deemed an event of default under the Note, a material breach under this Warrant, and a material breach under the Purchase Agreement.</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:11.95pt;margin-bottom:10pt;text-indent:72pt;margin-right:11.35pt'>(a)</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:6pt;text-indent:36pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.35pt'>If the Market Price of one share of Class A Common Stock is greater than the Exercise Price, then the Holder may elect to receive Warrant Shares pursuant to a cashless exercise, in lieu of a cash exercise, equal to the value of this Warrant determined in the manner described below (or of any portion thereof remaining unexercised) by surrender of this Warrant and an Exercise Notice, in which event the Company shall issue to Holder a number of Class A Common Stock computed using the following formula:</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:12.6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-right:16.05pt;color:#4F81BD'><FONT style=color:#000000><B>X =</B><B> </B></FONT><FONT style='color:#000000;border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Y</B><B> </B><B>(A-</B><B>B)</B></FONT></P>
<P align=center style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:12.05pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:16.05pt;margin-right:5.3pt'>A</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:12.1pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:48.15pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Cambria;margin-left:0pt'>Where X =</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD>the number of Shares to be issued to Holder.&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:11.95pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:120.15pt;margin-right:62.2pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Cambria;margin-left:-36pt'>Y =</KBD>the number of Warrant Shares that the Holder elects to purchase under this Warrant (at the date of such calculation).&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:12.3pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:84.15pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Cambria;margin-left:0pt'>A =</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:36pt></KBD>the Market Price (at the date of such calculation).&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:84.15pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Cambria;margin-left:0pt'>B =</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:36pt></KBD>Exercise Price (as adjusted to the date of such calculation).&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:11.75pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-right:11.45pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>(a)</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:114.9pt></KBD><I>No Fractional Shares</I>. No fractional shares shall be issued upon the exercise of this Warrant as a consequence of any adjustment pursuant hereto. All Warrant Shares (including fractions) issuable upon exercise of this Warrant may be aggregated for purposes of determining whether the exercise would result in the issuance of any fractional share. If, after aggregation, the exercise would result in the issuance of a fractional share, the Company shall, in lieu of issuance of any fractional share, pay the Holder otherwise entitled to such fraction a sum in cash equal to the product resulting from multiplying the then-current fair market value of a Warrant Share by such fraction.&nbsp;</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-right:11.6pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>(b)</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:114.95pt></KBD><I>Holder&#8217;s Exercise Limitations</I>. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained herein, the Company shall not effect any exercise of this Warrant, and a Holder shall not have the right to exercise any portion of this Warrant, pursuant to Section 1 or otherwise, to the extent that after giving effect to such issuance after exercise as set forth on the applicable Exercise Notice, the Holder (together with the Holder&#8217;s affiliates (the &#8220;Affiliates&#8221;), and any other Persons acting as a group together with the Holder or any of the&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'> &nbsp;calculation hereunder. The limitations contained in this paragraph shall apply to  &nbsp;&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'> &nbsp;a successor holder of this Warrant respective Holder&#8217;s Affiliates (such Persons, &#8220;Attribution Parties&#8221;)), would beneficially own in excess of the Beneficial Ownership Limitation (as defined below). For purposes of the foregoing sentence, the number of shares of Class A Common Stock beneficially owned by the Holder and Attribution Parties shall include the number of shares of Class A Common Stock issuable upon exercise of this Warrant with respect to which such determination is being made, but shall exclude the number of shares of Class A Common Stock which would be issuable upon (i) exercise of the remaining, nonexercised portion of this Warrant beneficially owned by the Holder or any of its Affiliates or Attribution Parties and (ii) exercise or conversion of the unexercised or nonconverted portion of any other securities of the Company (including, without limitation, any other Class A Common Stock Equivalents) subject to a limitation on conversion or exercise analogous to the limitation contained herein beneficially owned by the Holder or any of its Affiliates or Attribution Parties. Except as set forth in the preceding sentence, for purposes of this Section 1(c), beneficial ownership shall be calculated in accordance with Section 13(d) of the Exchange Act and the rules and regulations promulgated thereunder, it being acknowledged by the Holder that the Holder is solely responsible for any schedules required to be filed in accordance therewith. In addition, a determination as to any group status as contemplated above shall </P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P align=justify style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>be determined in accordance with Section 13(d) of the Exchange Act and the rules and regulations promulgated thereunder. For purposes of this Section 1(c), in determining the number of outstanding shares of Class A Common Stock, a Holder may rely on the number of outstanding shares of Class A Common Stock as reflected in (A) the Company&#8217;s most recent periodic or annual report filed with the Commission, as the case may be, (B) a more recent public announcement by the Company or (C) a more recent written notice by the Company or the Company&#8217;s transfer agent setting forth the number of shares of Class A Common Stock outstanding.</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P align=justify style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:3.7pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.5pt'>Upon the written or oral request of a Holder, the Company shall within two Trading Days confirm orally and in writing to the Holder the number of shares of Class A Common Stock then outstanding. In any case, the number of outstanding shares of Class A Common Stock shall be determined after giving effect to the conversion or exercise of securities of the Company, including this Warrant, by the Holder or its Affiliates or Attribution Parties since the date as of which such number of outstanding shares of Class A Common Stock was reported. The &#8220;Beneficial Ownership Limitation&#8221; shall be 4.99% of the number of shares of the Class A Common Stock outstanding at the time of the </P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.85pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'>2.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>ADJUSTMENTS</FONT>. The Exercise Price and the number of Warrant Shares shall be adjusted from time to time as follows:&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:12.6pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:5.55pt;margin-right:5.75pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:76.45pt'>(a)</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:103.4pt></KBD><I>Anti-Dilution Adjustments to Exercise Price</I>. If the Company or any Subsidiary thereof, as applicable, at any time while this Warrant is outstanding, shall sell or grant any option to purchase, or sell or grant any right to reprice, or otherwise dispose of or issue (or announce any offer, sale, grant or any option to purchase or other disposition) any Class A Common Stock or securities (including but not limited to Class A Common Stock Equivalents) entitling any person or entity (for purposes of clarification, including but not limited to the Holder pursuant to (i) any other security of the Company currently held by Holder, (ii) any other security of the Company issued to Holder on or after the Issuance Date (including but not limited to the Note), or (iii) any other agreement entered into between the Company and Holder) to acquire shares of Class A Common Stock (upon conversion, exercise or otherwise), at an effective price per share less than the then Exercise Price (such lower price, the &#8220;Base Share Price&#8221; and such issuances collectively, a &#8220;Dilutive Issuance&#8221;) (if the holder of the Class A Common Stock or Class A Common Stock Equivalents so issued shall at any time, whether by operation of purchase price adjustments, elimination of an applicable floor price for any &nbsp;</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:12.6pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:5.55pt;margin-right:5.75pt'>reason in the future (including but not limited to the passage of time or satisfaction of certain condition(s)), reset provisions, floating conversion, exercise or exchange prices or otherwise, or due to warrants, options or rights per share which are issued in connection with such issuance, be entitled or potentially entitled to receive shares of Class A Common Stock at an effective price per share which is less than the Exercise Price at any time while such Class A Common Stock or Class A Common Stock Equivalents are in existence, such issuance shall be deemed to have occurred for less than the Exercise Price on such date of the Dilutive Issuance (regardless of whether the Class A Common Stock or Class A Common Stock Equivalents are (i) subsequently redeemed or retired by the Company after the date of the Dilutive Issuance or (ii) actually converted or exercised at such Base Share Price), then the Exercise Price shall be reduced at the option of the Holder and only reduced to equal the Base Share Price, and the number of Warrant Shares issuable hereunder shall be increased such that the aggregate Exercise Price payable hereunder, after taking into account the decrease in the Exercise Price, shall be equal to the aggregate Exercise Price prior to such adjustment (for the avoidance of doubt, the aggregate Exercise Price prior to such adjustment is calculated as follows: the total number of Warrant Shares issuable upon exercise of this Warrant immediately prior to such adjustment (without regard to the Beneficial Ownership Limitation) multiplied by the Exercise Price in effect immediately prior to such adjustment). By way of example, if E is the total number of Warrant Shares issuable upon exercise of this Warrant immediately prior to such adjustment (without regard to the Beneficial Ownership Limitation), F is the Exercise Price in effect immediately prior to such adjustment, and G is the Base Share Price, the adjustment to the number of Warrant Shares can be expressed in the following formula: Total number of Warrant Shares after such Dilutive Issuance = the number obtained from dividing [E x F] by G. Such adjustment shall be made whenever such Class A Common Stock or Class A Common Stock Equivalents are issued, regardless of whether the Class A Common Stock or Class A Common Stock Equivalents </P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:12.6pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:5.55pt;margin-right:5.75pt'>are (i) subsequently redeemed or retired by the Company after the date of the Dilutive Issuance or (ii) actually converted or exercised at such Base Share Price by the holder thereof (for the avoidance of doubt, the Holder may utilize the Base Share Price even if the Company did not actually issue shares of its Class A Common stock at the Base Share Price under the respective Class A Common stock Equivalents). The Company shall notify the Holder in writing, no later than the Trading Day following the issuance of any Class A Common Stock or Class A Common Stock Equivalents subject to this Section 2(b), indicating therein the applicable issuance price, or applicable reset price, exchange price, conversion price and other pricing terms (such notice the &#8220;Dilutive Issuance Notice&#8221;). For purposes of clarification, regardless of whether (i) the Company provides a Dilutive Issuance Notice pursuant to this Section 2(b) upon the occurrence of any Dilutive Issuance or (ii) the Holder accurately refers to the number of Warrant Shares or Base Share Price in the Exercise Notice, the Holder is entitled to receive a number of Warrant Shares based upon the Base Share Price as well as the Base Share Price at all times on and after the date of such Dilutive Issuance.</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:12.5pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-right:11.45pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>(b)</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:114.9pt></KBD><I>Subdivision or Combination of Class A Common Stock</I>. If the Company at any time on or after the Issuance Date subdivides (by any stock split, stock dividend, recapitalization or otherwise) one or more classes of its outstanding shares of Class A Common Stock into a greater number of shares, the Exercise Price in effect immediately prior to such subdivision will be proportionately reduced and the number of Warrant Shares will be proportionately increased. If the Company at any time on or after the Issuance Date combines (by combination, reverse stock split or otherwise) one or more classes of its outstanding shares of Class A Common Stock into a smaller number of shares, the Exercise Price in effect immediately prior to such combination will be proportionately increased and the number of Warrant Shares will be proportionately decreased. Any adjustment under this Section 2(c) shall become effective at the close of business on the date the subdivision or combination becomes effective. Each such adjustment of the Exercise Price &nbsp;</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:12.5pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-right:11.45pt'>shall be calculated to the nearest one-hundredth of a cent. Such adjustment shall be made successively whenever any event covered by this Section 2(c) shall occur.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:9.55pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.3pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'>3.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:71.95pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>FUNDAMENTAL TRANSACTIONS</FONT>. If, at any time while this Warrant is outstanding, (i) the Company effects any merger of the Company with or into another entity and the Company is not the surviving entity (such surviving entity, the &#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Successor Entity</FONT>&#8221;), (ii) the Company effects any sale of all or substantially all of its assets in one or a series of related transactions, (iii) any tender offer or exchange offer (whether by the Company or by another individual or entity, and approved by the Company) is completed pursuant to which holders of Class A Common Stock are permitted to tender or exchange their shares of Class A Common Stock for other securities, cash or property and the holders of at least 50% of the Class A Common Stock accept such offer, or (iv) the Company effects any reclassification of the Class A Common Stock or any compulsory share exchange pursuant to which the Class A Common Stock is effectively converted into or exchanged for other securities, cash or property (other than as a result of a subdivision or combination of shares of Class A Common Stock) (in any such case, a &#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Fundamental</FONT> <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Transaction</FONT>&#8221;), then, upon any subsequent exercise of this Warrant, the Holder shall have the right to receive the number of shares of Class A Common Stock of the Successor Entity or of the Company and any additional consideration (the &#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Alternate Consideration</FONT>&#8221;) receivable upon or as a result of such reorganization, reclassification, merger, consolidation or disposition of assets by a holder of the number of shares of Class A Common Stock for which this Warrant is exercisable immediately prior to such event (disregarding any limitation on exercise contained herein solely for the purpose of such determination). For purposes of any such exercise, the &nbsp;</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:9.55pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.3pt'>determination of the Exercise Price shall be appropriately adjusted to apply to such Alternate Consideration based on the amount of Alternate Consideration issuable in respect of one share of Class A Common Stock in such Fundamental Transaction, and, the Company shall apportion the Exercise Price among the Alternate Consideration in a reasonable manner reflecting the relative value of any different components of the Alternate Consideration. If holders of Class A Common Stock are given any choice as to the securities, cash or property to be received in a Fundamental Transaction, then the Holder shall be given the same choice as to the Alternate Consideration it receives upon any exercise of this Warrant following such Fundamental Transaction. To the extent necessary to effectuate the foregoing provisions, any Successor Entity in such Fundamental Transaction shall issue to the Holder a new warrant consistent with the foregoing provisions and evidencing the Holder&#8217;s right to exercise such warrant into Alternate Consideration.</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:14.2pt;margin-right:11.3pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:0pt'>4.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:64.75pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>NON-CIRCUMVENTION</FONT>. The Company covenants and agrees that it will not, by amendment of its certificate of incorporation, bylaws or through any reorganization, transfer of assets, consolidation, merger, scheme of arrangement, dissolution, issue or sale of securities, or any other voluntary action, avoid or seek to avoid the observance or performance of any of the terms of this Warrant, and will at all times in good faith carry out all the provisions of this Warrant and take all action as may be required to protect the rights of the Holder. Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, the Company (i) shall not increase the par value of any shares of Class A Common Stock receivable upon the exercise of this Warrant above the Exercise Price then in effect, (ii) shall take all such actions as may be necessary or appropriate in order that the Company may validly and legally issue fully paid and non-assessable shares of Class A Common Stock upon the exercise of this Warrant, and (iii) shall, for so long as this Warrant is outstanding, have authorized and reserved, free from preemptive rights, three &nbsp;</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:14.2pt;margin-right:11.3pt'>(3) times the number of shares of Class A Common Stock into which the Warrants are then exercisable into to provide for the exercise of the rights represented by this Warrant (without regard to any limitations on exercise).</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:11.55pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.55pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'>5.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:71.95pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>WARRANT HOLDER NOT DEEMED A STOCKHOLDER</FONT>. Except as otherwise specifically provided herein, this Warrant, in and of itself, shall not entitle the Holder to any voting rights or other rights as a stockholder of the Company. In addition, nothing contained in this Warrant shall be construed as imposing any liabilities on the Holder to purchase any securities (upon exercise of this Warrant or otherwise) or as a stockholder of the Company, whether such liabilities are asserted by the Company or by creditors of the Company.&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:12.6pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:79pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:-36pt'>6.</KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>REISSUANCE</FONT>.&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:11.95pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-right:11.5pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>(a)</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:114.95pt></KBD><I>Lost, Stolen or Mutilated Warrant</I>. If this Warrant is lost, stolen, mutilated or destroyed, the Company will, on such terms as to indemnity or otherwise as it may reasonably impose (which shall, in the case of a mutilated Warrant, include the surrender thereof), issue a new Warrant of like denomination and tenor as this Warrant so lost, stolen, mutilated or destroyed.&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-right:11.7pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>(b)</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:114.9pt></KBD><I>Issuance of New Warrants</I>. Whenever the Company is required to issue a new Warrant pursuant to the terms of this Warrant, such new Warrant shall be of like tenor with this Warrant, and shall have an issuance date, as indicated on the face of such new Warrant which is the same as the Issuance Date.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.3pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'>7.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:71.95pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>TRANSFER</FONT>. This Warrant shall be binding upon the Company and its successors and assigns, and shall inure to be the benefit of the Holder and its successors and assigns. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, the rights, interests or obligations of the Company hereunder may not &nbsp;</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.3pt'>be assigned, by operation of law or otherwise, in whole or in part, by the Company without the prior signed written consent of the Holder, which consent may be withheld at the sole discretion of the Holder (any such assignment or transfer shall be null and void if the Company does not obtain the prior signed written consent of the Holder). This Warrant or any of the severable rights and obligations inuring to the benefit of or to be performed by Holder hereunder may be assigned by Holder to a third party, in whole or in part, without the need to obtain the Company&#8217;s consent thereto.</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.4pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'>8.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:71.95pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>NOTICES</FONT>. Whenever notice is required to be given under this Warrant, unless otherwise provided herein, such notice shall be given in accordance with the notice provisions contained in the Purchase Agreement. The Company shall provide the Holder with prompt written notice (i) immediately upon any adjustment of the Exercise Price, setting forth in reasonable detail, the calculation of such adjustment and (ii) at least 20 days prior to the date on which the Company closes its books or takes a record (A) with respect to any dividend or distribution upon the shares of Class A Common Stock, (B) with respect to any grants, issuances or sales of any stock or other securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for shares of Class A Common Stock or other property, pro rata to the holders of shares of Class A Common Stock or (C) for determining rights to vote with respect to any Fundamental Transaction, dissolution or liquidation, provided in each case that such information shall be made known to the public prior to or in conjunction with such notice being provided to the Holder.&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:43pt;margin-right:11.4pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-right:11.4pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:12.45pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.75pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'>9.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:71.95pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>AMENDMENT AND WAIVER</FONT>. The terms of this Warrant may be amended or waived (either generally or in a particular instance and either &nbsp;</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:12.45pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.75pt'>retroactively or prospectively) only with the written consent of the Company and the Holder.</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:12.45pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.75pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:12.45pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:43pt;margin-right:11.75pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.3pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'><B>10.</B></KBD><KBD style=margin-left:71.95pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>GOVERNING LAW AND VENUE</FONT>. This Warrant shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Florida without regard to principles of conflicts of laws. Any action brought by either party against the other concerning the transactions contemplated by this Warrant shall be brought only in the state courts located in Florida or federal courts located in Florida. The parties to this Warrant hereby irrevocably waive any objection to jurisdiction and venue of any action instituted hereunder and shall not assert any defense based on lack of jurisdiction or venue or based upon <I>forum non conveniens</I>. <B>EACH PARTY HEREBY IRREVOCABLY WAIVES ANY RIGHT IT MAY HAVE TO, AND AGREES NOT TO REQUEST, A JURY TRIAL FOR THE ADJUDICATION OF ANY DISPUTE HEREUNDER OR UNDER ANY OTHER TRANSACTION DOCUMENT ENTERED INTO IN CONNECTION WITH OR ARISING OUT OF THIS WARRANT OR ANY TRANSACTION CONTEMPLATED HEREBY OR</B>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.15pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.4pt'><B>THEREBY</B>. The prevailing party shall be entitled to recover from the other party its reasonable attorney's fees and costs. In the event that any provision of this Warrant or any other agreement delivered in connection herewith is invalid or unenforceable under any applicable statute or rule of law, then such provision shall be deemed inoperative to the extent that it may conflict therewith and shall be deemed modified to conform with such statute or rule of law. Any such provision which may prove invalid or unenforceable under any law shall not affect the validity or enforceability of any other provision of any agreement. Each party hereby irrevocably waives personal service of process and consents to process being served in any suit, action or proceeding </P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P align=justify style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.15pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.4pt'>in connection with this Warrant or any other transaction document entered into in connection with this Warrant by mailing a copy thereof via registered or certified mail or overnight delivery (with evidence of delivery) to such party at the address in effect for notices to it under the Purchase Agreement and agrees that such service shall constitute good and sufficient service of process and notice thereof. Nothing contained herein shall be deemed to limit in any way any right to serve process in any other manner permitted by law.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.15pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.4pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.15pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:7pt;margin-right:11.4pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.15pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-right:11.4pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:3.85pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:7.1pt;margin-right:11.4pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:0pt'>11.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:71.85pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>LEGAL COUNSEL OPINIONS</FONT>. Upon the request of the Buyer from to time to time, the Company shall be responsible (at its cost) for promptly supplying to the Company&#8217;s transfer agent and the Buyer a customary legal opinion letter of its counsel (the &#8220;Legal Counsel Opinion&#8221;) to the effect that the resale of the Exercise Shares (as defined in the Securities Purchase Agreement) by the Buyer or its affiliates, successors and assigns is exempt from the registration requirements of the 1933 Act pursuant to Regulation A+ (provided the Company has a qualified Regulation A+ offering), Rule 144 (provided the requirements of Rule 144 are satisfied and provided the Exercise Shares are not then registered under the 1933 Act for resale pursuant to an effective registration statement) or other applicable exemption (provided the requirements of such other applicable exemption are satisfied). In addition, the Buyer may (at the Company&#8217;s cost) at any time secure its own legal counsel to issue the Legal Counsel Opinion, and the Company will instruct its transfer agent to accept such opinion. The Company hereby agrees that it may never take the position that it is a &#8220;shell company&#8221; in connection with its obligations under this Agreement or otherwise.&nbsp;</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:7.1pt;margin-right:11.6pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:0pt'>12.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:71.85pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>ACCEPTANCE</FONT>. Receipt of this Warrant by the Holder shall constitute acceptance of and agreement to all of the terms and conditions contained herein.&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:7.1pt;margin-right:11.6pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.55pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:7.1pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:7.1pt;margin-right:11.75pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:0pt'>13.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:71.85pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>CERTAIN DEFINITIONS</FONT>. For purposes of this Warrant, the following terms shall have the following meanings:&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:7.1pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:43pt;margin-right:11.75pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:3.3pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-right:11.15pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>(a)</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:114.9pt></KBD>&#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Closing Sale Price</FONT>&#8221; means, for any security as of any date, (i) the last closing trade price for such security on the Principal Market, or other similar quotation service provider designated by the Holder, or, if the Principal Market begins to operate on an extended hours basis and does not designate the closing trade price, then the last trade price of such security prior to 4:00 p.m., New York time, or other similar quotation service provider designated by the Holder, or (ii) if the foregoing does not apply, the last trade price of such security in the over-the-counter market for such security or other similar quotation service provider designated by the Holder, or (iii) if no last trade price is reported for such security by other similar quotation service provider designated by the Holder, the average of the bid and ask prices of any market makers for such security as reported by other similar quotation service provider designated by the Holder. If the Closing Sale Price cannot be calculated for a security on a particular date on any of the foregoing bases, the Closing Sale Price of such security on such date shall be the fair market value as mutually determined by the Company and the Holder. All such determinations to be appropriately adjusted for any stock dividend, stock split, stock combination or other similar transaction during the applicable calculation period.&nbsp;</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-right:11.5pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>(b)</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:114.95pt></KBD>&#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Class A Common Stock</FONT>&#8221; means the Company&#8217;s Class A Common stock, and any other class of securities into which such securities may hereafter be reclassified or changed.&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:12.6pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-right:11.55pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>(c)</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:114.9pt></KBD>&#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Class A Common Stock Equivalents</FONT>&#8221; means any securities of the Company that would entitle the holder thereof to acquire at any time Class A Common Stock, including without limitation any debt, preferred stock, rights, options, warrants or other instrument that is at any time convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for, or otherwise entitles the holder thereof to receive, Class A Common Stock.&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:5.55pt;margin-right:5.7pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:73.45pt'>(d)</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:117pt></KBD>&#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Person</FONT>&#8221; and &#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Persons</FONT>&#8221; means an individual, a limited liability company, a partnership, a joint venture, a corporation, a trust, an unincorporated organization, any other entity and any governmental entity or any department or agency thereof.&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:36pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-left:79pt;margin-right:5.7pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-right:11.7pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>(e)</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:114.9pt></KBD>&#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Principal Market</FONT>&#8221; means the principal securities exchange or trading market where such Class A Common Stock is listed or quoted, including but not limited to any tier of the OTC Markets, any tier of the NASDAQ Stock Market (including NASDAQ Capital Market), or the NYSE American, or any successor to such markets.&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-right:11.55pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>(f)</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:114.9pt></KBD>&#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Market Price</FONT>&#8221; means the highest traded price of the Class A Common Stock during the one hundred and fifty Trading Days prior to the date of the respective Exercise Notice.&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-right:11.7pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:16pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>(g)</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:114.85pt></KBD>&#8220;<FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Trading Day</FONT>&#8221; means any day on which the Class A Common Stock is listed or quoted on its Principal Market, provided, however, &nbsp;</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:16pt Cambria;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;margin-right:11.7pt'>that if the Class A Common Stock is not then listed or quoted on any Principal Market, then any calendar day.</P>
